blockers: The clear-bag limit is misstated twice. The candidate says the bag must be “smaller than” 12 by 12 by 6 inches, while BC Place permits bags “no larger than” those dimensions. The candidate incorrectly excludes a bag exactly at the published maximum.

Several specific instructions attributed to official guidance, including increasing screen brightness, using Gate B for ticket help and the supporter-section restrictions, could not be verified from the accessible cited material. summary: BLOCKERS. The article is readable, scannable and locally useful, with no authorial em dashes. It needs correction of the clear-bag threshold, a tighter non-repetitive close and verification of claims unique to the unavailable Whitecaps spectator page before release.
